title: Durango’s Flock data by the numbers
summary: Durango Police Chief Brice Current delivered the city's first monthly Flock Safety report to City Council, detailing 794 officer searches, 315,798 unique vehicles detected 2.46 million times, 2,148 hotlist hits, and 24 arrests attributed to the system since 2024. City Council has resisted resident calls to cancel the Flock contract, opting instead for increased transparency via monthly reports, while DPD says it audits and blocks agencies with 287(g) ICE cooperation agreements from accessing its data.

key_quotes.quote: As cities around the country – Fort Collins among the latest – pull contracts with Flock Safety over privacy concerns, Durango City Council is instead suggesting more transparency about use of Flock cameras.
